quests.title: Chapter 1: Arrival in Lumenport
quests.description: Explore Arrival Square, claim your starter deck from Envoy Soren, and complete your first Convergence Duel against Kaelen Emberforge.

objectives.description: Speak with Soren of Whisperleaf in Arrival Square
Complete a Convergence Duel against Kaelen Emberforge

quests.title: Chapter 2: The Resonance Emporium
quests.description: Visit Master Artificer Vance in the Central Card Market, open a card pack or craft a card, and customize a legal 40-card deck.

objectives.description: Enter the Resonance Emporium and speak with Master Vance
Open 1 Foundations Card Pack or craft 1 card
Validate and save a legal 40-card deck

quests.title: Chapter 3: Duelist Plaza Qualifier
quests.description: Defeat Lyra Vane in Duelist Plaza and register with Grand Marshal Corin inside the Tournament Hall.

objectives.description: Win a Convergence Duel against Lyra Vane in Duelist Plaza
Speak with Grand Marshal Corin in the Tournament Registration Rotunda

quests.title: Chapter 4: The Four-Banner Tag Trial
quests.description: Recruit a bonded NPC companion or join an online 2v2 Tag lobby and complete a four-duelist Tag Convergence match.

objectives.description: Reach Friendly (40+) bond with any companion NPC
Complete a 2v2 Tag Convergence Duel (Co-op or 4-Client Online)

quests.title: Side Quest: Lenses of the Mirror Spire
quests.description: Assist Eluned Prismwright and Lyra Vane in the Calibration Workshop by inspecting and approving Echo card artwork.

objectives.description: Visit the Choir & Prism Calibration Workshop
Test Glassborne Refraction in a duel with Eluned Prismwright

quests.title: Side Quest: Undertow at the Old Breakwater
quests.description: Meet Captain Nerissa Wake at the Anchor & Aether Café and master Tidebound lane-shifting Current mechanics.

objectives.description: Speak with Mira Solis and Captain Nerissa inside the Harbor Café
Defeat Captain Nerissa Wake at the harbor table

quests.title: Side Quest: Whispers on Lantern Row
quests.description: Uncover the Nocturne cipher in Lantern Row and duel Vesper of the Crescent Mask under twilight rules.

objectives.description: Inspect your Duelist Loft Apartment with Toma Wick
Challenge Vesper of the Crescent Mask

quests.title: Side Quest: The Ninth Hour Conjunction
quests.description: Ascend to the Accord Institute Observatory and test your deck against Astromancer Celeste’s Alignment predictions.

objectives.description: Speak with Astromancer Celeste at the Accord Institute
Complete an Alignment duel against Astromancer Celeste
